# Coding Agent Instructions

- Work in the context of this GitHub repository.
- Follow the existing architecture and coding conventions.
- Keep changes focused on the requested task.
- Write or update tests where appropriate.
- Run relevant tests and report failures.
- Never commit directly to main.
- Use a separate feature branch for independent work.
- Commit and push completed changes.
- Create a pull request against main when appropriate.
- Summarise changes and any outstanding issues.
